batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c AJ Finch b KV Sharma

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c P Negi b SK Raina

batting.name: DJG Sammy
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b RA Jadeja

balls.text: 24 off that Steyn over! Steyn bowls length and Dhoni chips this over the on side and one bounce and four to deep midwicket
he forces this one down to deep midwicket for a couple
Steyn's nightmare continues against MSD, he fires this one full and Dhoni launches this one over long-off, goes a few rows back and it's his fifty as well!
mistimes this one towards long-on and they scamper for a couple
raw power! This was fuller and he put a lot of bottom hand behind that biff down to long-on, there was a fielder and he too couldn't get there
nothing wrong with the new bat there! Steyn bowls it full on middle and leg and he scoops it high and over deep midwicket
missed out there, a low full toss and he mistimes it to long-off and he seems to have damaged the bat
slams a full ball on the bounce down to long-off and that's Hussey's fifty!
just one, Dhoni shuffled across his stumps to sweep that and it was a good yorker, hits his pads and rolls away
yorker outside off which he squirts down to third man
low full toss and he drills it back to the bowler, a dot ball here
it's a misfield at cover and Irfan's the culprit, Dhoni drilled a full ball hard at him and he let it slip and as a result Warner had to do a lot of mopping up near the rope
Hussey approaching a fifty here, this was a length ball on the pads and he pulls in front of square and sends it a few rows over deep midwicket
on the pads and chipped uppishly to long-on
looked to slam that over the on side and missed and Ojha belted out an appeal, he was up to the stumps and Irfan joined in too but the umpire wasn't interested
that was the slower bouncer that foxed Dhoni too, it was rising up and he very half heartedly looked to play the upper cut, neither here nor there and he made no contact
fullish on middle and leg and swept down to deep midwicket
Irfan bowls the slower ball but back fires as Hussey makes room and slams it over long-off, had to put more power behind that
fullish outside off and driven down to long-off
low full toss and he clips it firmly down to deep midwicket
hammers it down the track and well stopped by the bowler
he drills this full ball down to long-off who dives but it still costs two
close call for Dhini but it goes off Finch's palms! This was a length ball which he pulls firmly to long-on, Finch leaps at the edge of the rope but parries it over the rope
keeper up to the stumps and Dhoni goes for a big swing and misses it completely
length ball again and he gets forward and sweeps him behind square leg, he placed it well and the boundary rider couldn't dive and stop it
he looks to play the reverse sweep but can't get it past Bhuvneshwar at short third man
fires it down the leg side and well taken by Ojha, he breaks the stumps too but Dhoni's home

looked to scoop it down to fine leg, the ball hits his shoulder and lobs up and drops in front of the crease, he then looks to obstruct the ball going towards the stumps and Ojha takes it on the bounce
he drills it down to long-off
placement again by Hussey! This was a length ball by Sammy from round the wicket, pick-up shot over the leg side, the deep square leg fielder couldn't stop it
a bit short and he mistimes the pull to long-on
excellent placement by Hussey, this was the slower ball and he gives him width, Hussey knew there was a gap at third man and placed it well wide of the fielder in the circle
driven firmly but well stopped by Sammy at mid-off
he has woken up! This was a bit too short from Pathan, he pulled it in front of square and went flat over long-on
chance for a run out! He made room and pushed it to mid-off and challenged Sammy who took aim and missed at the bowler's end, Hussey was struggling
a boundary finally, the keeper was up to the stumps, Hussey makes room to a length ball and carves it over point, vacant spaces there
this time Steyn cranks up the pace and bowls it shorter and he plays high on the bat and steers it to third man, good over
he stays back to a length ball and punches it to the off side
turning out to be a good over, this was fuller and Dhoni was going for the drive outside off and misses
and this time Steyn gets away with width, loose ball but Dhoni slashes and misses
Steyn does well to cramp him up for room again, all he can do is stay back and defend
he stays back and punches it down to cover
Hussey struggling there as he is cramped for room, he gets an inside edge to the pads
keeping the runs down, he makes room and cuts hard but straight to point
makes room and punches it to point, quiet over
he has some room to cut and he cuts to cover
makes room and cuts towards point
he stays back and punches him to mid-off
full and driven really hard down to long-off
drops it a bit short and he pulls him to deep square leg
he stays back and punches it to long-off
flatter one and he pushes it to the bowler
round the wicket and Dhoni gives the charge and looks to slam it over the on side, didn't control it and he chipped it towards deep square leg
he stays back and works it to square leg
fullish on the pads and he works it down to long-on
flatter one and he softly pushes it back to the bowler
tossed up and he comes down the track and pushes it to long-off
drops it flat and short and he pulls it down to fine leg
Karn errs by dropping it a bit short of a length and giving him width, made a bit of room himself before cutting him hard past backward point
fuller and flatter and he works it down to long-on
round the wicket this time to Dhoni as he clips this one down to long-on
checks his drive down to cover
flatter one and he drills this down to long-on
looks to paddle and the ball deflects off Ojha's pads
flatter one and clipped to mid-on
makes room and drives this one to long-off
gets forward and mistimes it back to the bowler
lunges forward and pushes it to the off side

Raina perishes to the big shot early in his innings, it was a top spinner from Karn and Raina was down the track and looked to loft it over the sight screen, didn't get the distance, Finch jogged to his left from long-off and held it
makes the mistake of bowling to the pads, Raina gets down to sweep and the ball clips his pads and beats short fine leg
punched towards point and B Kumar does well to dive and stop it
gets forward and pushes it down to mid-off
flatter and shorter and he pulls along the ground to fine leg
turned straight to short midwicket
drifts back in and he tucks it to the leg side
tries to slice it but can't beat backward point
stays back and punches with the turn to long-on
waits for the turn and punches it off the back foot to long-on
Hussey plays it safe first ball as he shoulders arms to Karn

trapped on the back foot and quite plumb, this should come as a huge relief for SRH, this was the googly which Smith failed to read, he went on the back foot and looked to whip it away, didn't read the turn and was trapped
gets an inside edge to the pads and it lobs up and Ojha runs to his left and dives but can't get to it
Smith's making this look very easy, tossed up on middle and leg and he chips this one goes flat over long-on
flatter one on the pads and worked down to deep square leg
he stays back and punches it down to long-on
whams this one flat down to long-on, fielder is back there, expensive over by Rasool
gets off the mark with a clip down to midwicket
plays the reverse sweep but mistimes it to short third man
three out of three! This was higher in the air, he came forward and lofted it down to the sight screen, didn't look in control initially but good enough
over the on side! Tossed up on middle and he gets forward and chips this over deep midwicket
down the ground! Tossed up and Smith doesn't leave the crease at all, comes forward and lofts him down to the sight screen
clips it down to mid-on and takes an easy single
skids onto him and he mistimes it to the on side
difficult chance at cover, Smith reaches out and drives in the air and Rao does well at cover to fling himself to his left but Smith's placement got the better of him
big swing and a miss, Smith nowhere near the ball as he looked to pound this to the on side
goes right back at the crease and punches back to Steyn, Raina ensures he goes back to his crease
mistimed by Smith, he had some width and chopped it to the off side
stays back and clips a googly down to midwicket
stays back and punches it to the on side

the stumps are cartwheeling! At the bowler's end though...very unfortunate way to get out, this was a full blooded straight drive in the air by Smith, du Plessis had  left his crease and Sharma got a finger to it before it struck the stumps and du Plessis walked off
struck him on the pads on the back foot and a stifled appeal, it was actually an inside edge
Du Plessis gives the charge straightaway and checks his drive to mid-off
on the stumps and tucked away down to deep square leg, fielder was pushed back
mid-on is pushed back and it's another single down the ground
he clips it to the on side
close call for Smith as he took off and Faf quickly sent him back, throw to the bowler's end was wide
and normal service resumes, he takes a few paces down the track to a length ball and merely pushes it into the gap at mid-off and it races away
finally a single, and this time a quiet one down to long-on
another expensive over! Steyn too straight again and this time du Plessis effortlessly whips it over midwicket
stays back and pushes it to the off side
class! An effortless push by du Plessis, he used the pace by Steyn to play a forward push and the ball rocketed past mid-off, too full by Steyn
punches it to cover and tells Smith to stay back
a bit too straight, pacy one on the pads and he flicks it away with ease in the air wide of square leg
fullish ball and he flicks it down to midwicket
poor opening over from Kumar, this was wide outside off and he square drives this wide if backward point
drilled firmly down the ground, hit hard wide of the bowler and Irfan was at long-on running to his left and he looked to have it covered, he didn't dive properly
good length on the pads and tucked towards mid-on
had all the width he could ask for, moving away and he bends and reaches out and carves it over cover, easily done
this was short and wide outside off and he reaches out and mistimes the cut to point
lands it on a length outside off and softly pushed towards mid-off
the field was up and Rao decides to go airborne, tossed up and he lofts him one bounce down to long-on and it's a win with two balls to spare
they scamper through for a single as Dhawan digs it out to point, Hastings' throw was all over the place
Sammy has given it away here! This was dropped on a length and he was looking to muscle that over long-on and the fielder ran forward and took the catch
Appeal for a stumping! Dhawan was reaching out outside off to drive and he was beaten and he just about managed to drag his back foot back, the third umpire takes a look
Dhawan comes down the track and lofts it nicely over midwicket, picks the gap

he;s been given out run out! Finch moved back and cuts it hard towards cover, misfield by Raina, he set off and the throw was to the bowler who broke the stumps, the umpire didn't ask for the third umpire
he makes room and delicately dabs him to short third man
no sighters for Finch, he dances down the track and lofts him clean over deep midwicket
has it come too late for Sunrisers? Tossed up on the pads and he looks to clear deep square leg and Negi runs to his left and judges it well
softly clipped to the on side and Ojha wasn't actually ready
punches this one down to long-on
this is a low full toss which he punches towards mid-off, Negi dives
it's been that kind of evening for Super Kings, Dhawan gives the charge, he gets an inside edge that sneaks past the stumps and bisects the gap between the keeper and short fine leg
a bit too straight and he swivels and clips it to the deep to bring up his fifty!
he comes down the track and looks to swish that away somewhere but ends up swishing at thin air
slower ball outside off and he punches it to Faf at point
he comes forward and pushes it down to long-on
makes room to punch but can't beat point
looks to sweep and the ball rolls off the pads
Raina gets his length wrong as well, a half tracker waiting to be spanked, he makes room and clubs it over deep midwicket
drops it short and he works it wide of midwicket
he comes down the track and works it just wide of the bowler
makes room and mistimes the punch to the off side
fullish on the pads and flicked to the leg side
waits for it to turn and works it to deep midwicket
he stays back and punches it to the off side
over the second tier! That was launched downtown over the sight screen, gives Negi the charge and lofts cleanly
stays back and punches it to long-off
he makes room and punches it to the off side
he looks to slog him again but mistimes it to deep midwicket
flatter and quicker on the pads and he works it to deep square leg, Mohit has some work to do and they complete two
4 + 6! Tossed up by Jadeja and Dhawan gets on his knee early and slogs him high over deep square leg
that's a poor length and line by Jadeja, fine leg is up and he drops it short and wide down the leg side, pummeled to fine leg
drops it a bit short and he pulls him down to long-on
on the pads and he works it to square leg
makes room and drives hard down the pitch but straight to the fielder
comes down the track and checks the punch to long-on
he drops it a bit short and cuts him to deep point
drifts on the pads and he works it to fine leg
punched that straight to cover, good comeback over by Hastings
he opens the face and steers it down to third man
well stopped by Raina near mid-on
stays back and punches to the off side

Warner's dragged it on, but bizarrely it took Hastings a few seconds for that to register, Warner was at the crease looking to push it through the off side but got an inside edge to the leg stump, Dhawan set out from his crease and Hastings was actually gesturing to the fielder to throw the ball to him so he could effect a run out, no need for that
strange old shot, this was a slower ball bowled short down the leg side, fine leg was up but he played too early and tamely pulled it to the deep on the on side
Dhawan into the act now, this was dropped a bit short and wide outside off, he saw the third man up and sliced it well wide of him
continues to bowl it short and he pulls to deep square leg
he comes down the track and punches it towards long-on
he drops it short and he pulls him down to long-on
asking to be spanked, this was a half tracker and he goes back and pulls him over deep square leg
Negi drops it short and he pushes it to long-on
fetches it from outside off and pulls against the turn and places it well enough to pick up two
very good running, Dhawan pushes it with soft hands towards cover and calls and Warner is quick to respond
Ashwin drops it short and he swivels and pulls him to deep square leg
stays back, waits for the turn and clips it to midwicket
good length on the pads and he works it to midwicket
fullish in length outside off and pushed to mid-off
he clips it down to deep square leg
he clips it to midwicket
good stop by Hastings this time, this was fired down the leg side and Hastings ran quickly to his left from short fine leg
forced away down to deep midwicket
that nearly carried to the second tier, that was a clean blow, tossed up and on his knee, slogged over deep midwicket
Hastings made a mess of it at short fine leg, it was down the leg side and paddled and Hastings turned to his right first and realised late he should have turned the other way
he slides this one wide down the leg side
comes down the track and drops it short on seeing him advance, he works it to deep square leg
cramps him for room and he comes forward and blocks
down the track and clips it behind square towards fine leg
he comes down the track and checks the loft to long-off
bowls it shorter and he makes room and punches it wide of point
he goes back and punches it to mid-on
drops it a bit short and wide and he cuts to point
fuller ball on the pads and he works it to deep square leg
paddles it down to square leg
drives a fuller ball down to long-on
looked to play the reverse sweep but the ball hits his pads outside the line, stifled appeal
length ball on the pads and worked to the leg side
he drops it in front of cover and sets off
finds the gap, length ball outside off and he makes room and crunches it wide of cover who dives in vain
Free Hit: He gets a boundary off it, an attempted yorker and it's a low full toss which he clips wide of short fine leg and he gets his fifty too!
that's a massive front foot no ball, he drills this towards cover
it's a full toss and Warner makes room to heave it away and the ball drops short of midwicket who dives, the ball deflects off the fielder and rolls to long-on and the long-on fielder can't stop it
this time he bowls length and it's in the slot for Warner to loft him over the on side, down to wide long-on
short fine leg is in place and he bowls on  the pads, easily worked away to fine leg by Warner
skids through and hits his pads as he looks to work it away
punched to the off side and good stop at extra cover
drops it a bit short and he pulls him to square leg
tries to work it off his pads but can't beat short fine leg
makes room and punches it to mid-off who's a bit deep
down the track and drives on the up wide of the bowler to long-off
he comes down the track and pushes it straight to cover
driven hard but can't beat Manhas at mid-off
Hastings makes the mistake of feeding a full ball on the pads, good use of the wrists as he finds the gap wide of mid-on
stays back and punches it towards cover and tells Warner to wait
this was fuller and pushed towards mid-off, good running by the pair as they put pressure on Manhas
keeps it straight and he can only punch it back to the bowler
Hastings lands it on a length outside off and driven hard to cover
misfield at extra cover allows Dhawan to retain strike off a backfoot punch
just back of a good length and pushing in on off stump, Dhawan blocks
nudged behind square leg and that area is quite vacant
spears it in on middle and leg, Warner whips it through midwicket
Mohit is not learning. He is allowing Warner to extend his arms. Perhaps the plan is to bowl beyond his reach on the off side, but it isn't working. belted over cover
width and Warner tucks into it. Clears his front leg out of the way and mauls it over the head of point. Well over
backs away and lashes the fuller delivery to mid-off
angles it in on a fuller length and Warner slams it down to the long-on boundary. Very clean
trapped on the back foot. Not too much spin on offer and Warner was waiting for some. Adjusts and defends
flattens his trajectory and Warner comes forward and blocks
just a little flight and Warner latches onto it. Plants his front leg down the line and hoists him into the sight screen. Had to reach for it, but he struck it powerfully
drifting on the pads, Dhawan goes deep in his crease and works it behind square leg
switches around the wicket and bowls a little shortish on off stump, Warner opens the face towards point
belted down the ground! Mohit invited the drive and Warner obliged with immense power. Guess that answers that
sticks closer to off stump and Warner pushes to cover off the back foot
this time he offers room and Warner places it wide of point. His timing has been pretty good throughout the season and this time it's no different
goes a touch fuller, but Warner is happy to remain in his crease and punch into the covers
right behind this short of a good length ball on off stump. Nice solid defensive
